name: drill-throughput
desc: Drill end-to-end throughput: walk to the vein (GOTO, impl-sensitive), dig a shaft down through SOLID ground (DESCEND, greedy-only), mine a 3x3x3 embedded iron cluster (MINE/DIG_TO, greedy-only). Whole-mission throughput per planner (astar, dstar) — NOT a pure nav A/B (the point-to-point legs are that). Geometry: a COMPACT solid stone hill (~600 blocks — kept small so the /fill doesn't strain the integrated server) with no void: a narrow pre-dug shaft over cleared air would trip the descend deep-fall guard once GOTO's ~2.5-block arrival lands the bot off the column, so it's solid. The precise-descend fix (anchor the shaft to the MARKER column, not the arrival block) is what this exercises end-to-end: GOTO arrives off-column, DESCEND walks ONTO the marker (GoalXZ) before cutting, so the 3x3x3 iron at the marker is always exposed. x96+ so it never overlaps the flat/climb/detour/gap arenas.
